adjudication.rationale: In `BookingListItem.tsx`, the new `add_members` option is appended to `optionItems` unconditionally (no checks around organizer/team role/attendee status) and always opens `AddGuestsDialog`. On the server, `addGuestsHandler` enforces permissions (`!isTeamAdminOrOwner && !isOrganizer && !isAttendee` => `FORBIDDEN`). The diff therefore shows a UI/server permission mismatch: the UI advertises an action without mirroring the server gating, which can lead to a poor UX (user only learns via error toast after submission). However, from the diff alone we can’t verify that the booking list ever includes bookings for which the current user is neither organizer nor attendee (or admin/owner), so the failure case isn’t fully provable here.
